inline_text:
Adds an entry (#18) and summary-table row for `action_ref` / Mycelium Trails, following the existing entry format.

`action_ref` is a post-hoc, third-party-verifiable action accountability primitive — narrow scope, complementary to the WG's session-trace model rather than competing with it: the WG's work answers *what an agent did and in what structure*; `action_ref` answers a narrower, orthogonal question, *is this particular recorded action verifiable by someone who doesn't trust whoever reported it*. Production-anchored (Arbitrum), specified in an IETF individual draft ([draft-etcheverry-action-ref](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-etcheverry-action-ref/), still pre-adoption).

No claim of replacing OTel/AOS/AGNTCY — sits one layer beneath, consistent with the doc's own "interoperability over invention" framing.
